description: This file implements the DeviceConfig class for the modem simulator in the Cuttlefish project, providing methods to retrieve configuration details and open file streams.

classes.name: DeviceConfig
classes.description: A class providing configuration access methods for the modem simulator in Cuttlefish.

methods.name: host_id
methods.description: Returns the host ID for the device, defaulting to 1000 if configuration is unavailable.

methods.name: PerInstancePath
methods.description: Returns the per-instance file path for a given filename.

methods.name: DefaultHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Returns the default host artifacts path for a given file.

methods.name: ril_address_and_prefix
methods.description: Returns the RIL IP address and prefix in CIDR notation.

methods.name: open_ifstream_crossplat
methods.description: Opens an input file stream for the specified filename.

methods.name: open_ofstream_crossplat
methods.description: Opens an output file stream for the specified filename with the given mode.
